name: Default
shortDescription: IT asset and license management with check-in/check-out tracking, audits and a REST API, backed by MariaDB.

alerts.message: Open the app right after deployment: the setup wizard creates the first administrator account, and whoever completes it first becomes the admin.
Outgoing email is written to the container log by default. Set MAIL_MAILER to smtp and fill in the MAIL_* variables to send password resets and notifications.
